blurb: Guests can rent professionally constructed rehearsal and recording studios with soundproofing and quality gear. The distillery also offers a unique tasting room/event space for private events such as birthdays, weddings, and corporate parties. The venue includes a cocktail room with a vintage industrial vibe and ample free parking.
